title: Callvale before: no detection
claim: At month 19, seven accounts run without detection services, and the bank's questions about threats and evidence stay unanswered.
alt: Seven AWS accounts in three organizational units: management; log-archive and security; network; dev, staging and prod. No detection service is turned on. A weekly checklist by hand touches the prod account only. Four open questions from the bank: changes in production, card numbers in transcripts, software vulnerabilities, stolen credentials.
notes: Brief 09 story pair, 2-deep.md#decision-record (after Context); no steps. Claim and alt copied from brief.json. Same cells as detection-after: accounts in rows 1 to 3, the bank's four questions in A4:A7 (each becomes the service that answers it), the manual checklist in B5:B6 (becomes Security Hub). dev, staging and prod share one node so that the after picture stays at 12 nodes. Story numbers only (7 accounts, 3 OUs, month 19); no AWS number in the drawing.
